description: Get the INTERNAL level names of up to 5 companies for a job family, each ordered by seniority (e.g. Google L3/L4/L5, Meta E3/E4/E5, Stripe IC1/IC2/IC3), with any alternate names per level. Pass every company you are comparing in one call. Use this FIRST when a question names a specific level at a specific company (e.g. "what does a Meta E5 make"), then call get-salaries-by-company-level. A company with no known level structure comes back with an empty list and an explanation. Free limit: Full level data for Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Meta and Apple. Other companies: level names only. Pass canonical slugs (jobFamilySlug, locationSlug(s), countrySlug, companySlug(s)): resolve names first with search-job-families, search-locations and search-companies; never guess a slug. REQUIRED arguments: companySlugs, jobFamilySlug. Array-typed arguments (companySlugs) must be passed as arrays, even for a single value.

companySlugs.description: Up to 5 company slugs whose internal level structure to list, compared in one call, e.g. ["google", "meta"]. Resolve each with search-companies first.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

name: get-company-levels
